description: Monitor only Docker images and Helm chart dependencies. All other package managers (Gradle/Maven/npm under src/) are disabled - TAK Server's own dependency tree is intentionally not tracked here.

packageRules.description: TAK Server images are built and tagged from this repository's git version (5.7-RELEASE-*) - do not attempt to update them.
postgis is pinned to PostgreSQL 15 + PostGIS 3 - TAK Server requires postgresql-15-postgis-3. Only allow patch tags within that line.
